description: D1 Training is an athletic-based training franchise founded in 2001 by former NFL player Will Bartholomew. Headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, D1 operates training facilities for scholastic athletes ages 7-18 and adults, modeled on Division 1 strength and conditioning principles across five core tenets: dynamic warm-up, performance, strength, core and conditioning, and cool down. The franchisor, D1 Sports Franchise, LLC, began offering franchises in 2015 and is backed by Princeton Equity Group. Per the 2025 FDD, the franchise fee is $59,500, total initial investment ranges from $480,557 to $933,432, royalties are 7% of gross sales, and Item 19 reports average 2024 gross revenue of $679,601 across 31 substantially similar franchised locations. The system grew to 129 outlets by end of 2024 and surpassed 165 training facilities nationwide by end of 2025, earning a fourth straight Entrepreneur Franchise 500 ranking.
